scope.overview:
This system automates social media engagement across Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram for your business. You define a topic or business context, the system searches all three platforms for relevant recent conversations, uses AI to analyze which posts are worth engaging, generates contextual comments for each, and surfaces them in a web dashboard for your review and approval.

Once you approve a comment in the dashboard, the system automatically logs into your social media account and posts it using browser automation, exactly as a human user would. No third-party APIs that expose your activity or add cost. The result is a semi-automated engagement pipeline that finds the right conversations, drafts the right replies, and lets you stay in control of what actually gets posted.
steps: Define your business context: product, target audience, keywords to monitor, and preferred reply tone, stored as persistent AI instructions
Set up the web scraping layer using Firecrawl or a comparable tool to pull recent public posts from Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram based on your chosen topic
Build the AI relevance filter: Claude analyzes each scraped post and scores it for relevance, discarding noise and only surfacing posts that match your engagement criteria
Build the comment generation engine: for each approved post, Claude drafts a natural, contextual reply in the tone and voice you specify
Build the web dashboard on Vercel: a clean interface showing matched posts with their source platform, a short AI summary, category tags, and the generated comment alongside an Approve or Skip action
Build the Reddit posting agent using Chrome DevTools MCP: when a comment is approved, the system opens a browser, navigates to the Reddit post, and submits the comment from your account
Build the Facebook posting agent using Chrome DevTools MCP: same flow for Facebook, navigating to the post and submitting the comment through the Facebook UI
Build the Instagram posting agent using Chrome DevTools MCP: same flow for Instagram comments and replies
Set up VPS hosting and a static proxy IP so the browser automation always operates from a consistent location, preventing account flags from IP changes
Build the activity log: every post found, match decision, generated comment, approval status, and posting timestamp is recorded to a Google Sheet after each run
Run end-to-end tests across all three platforms, tune the relevance scoring and comment prompts through real runs, and hand over a stable, production-ready system
scope.architecture: The system uses a three-layer design: a scraping layer that collects raw posts, an AI layer that filters and generates comments, and a browser automation layer that posts approved comments. All browser interactions happen through Chrome DevTools MCP running on a VPS with a static proxy IP.

stack.purpose: Controls a real Chrome browser to navigate and post comments on Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram without using their APIs
Pulls recent public posts from target platforms based on topic keywords for AI analysis
Analyzes post relevance, categorizes conversations, and generates natural contextual comments in your voice
Web interface for reviewing matched posts, reading AI-generated comments, and approving or skipping each one
Connects the dashboard to the scraping layer, AI engine, and browser automation; manages approval state
Hosts the system so it runs 24/7 without your computer needing to be on; static IP prevents account flags from location changes
Records every post found, match decision, generated comment, approval status, and posting timestamp for performance review

risks.mitigation: All browser interactions use human-like timing and pacing through Chrome DevTools MCP. Static proxy IP ensures consistent location. Account activity stays within natural engagement volumes.
Comment posting is rate-limited to a safe daily cap. Account warm-up period is observed before automation begins. Approval gate prevents bulk unreviewed posting.

risks.risk: Scraped post volume is too high or too noisy
risks.mitigation: The AI relevance filter is tuned per business context. Dashboard includes category filters so you can focus on specific conversation types (new buyers, questions, complaints, etc.).
Posts from private groups require the account to be a member. The system only engages content the logged-in account already has access to. Group joining is done manually.
All automation runs through a real browser as a logged-in user, the same way a human would use the site. No official API is used, so API policy changes do not affect the system.

security_notes: Your social media credentials are stored only on your VPS in a local environment file and are never transmitted to any third party
The system uses your own accounts, not shared or pooled accounts, so all activity is traceable only to you
Static proxy IP prevents login anomalies that could trigger account security reviews
The approval gate ensures no comment is posted without your explicit confirmation
All intermediate data (scraped posts, AI outputs) is stored locally on the VPS and cleared after each run
